column2: AI education APAC Asia Pacific 2026 adoption regulation players
column5: Korea Framework (AI Basic) Act in force 22 Jan 2026; 250k AI-literate workers/yr target. VIETNAM Law on AI 134/2025/QH15 in force 1 Mar 2026, with education transition to 1 SEP 2027, and Decision 33/2026/QD-TTg names EDUCATION among six high-risk sectors (automated assessment, behavioural monitoring). China targeted rules; Japan/Singapore/Australia voluntary; India no AI law. Ipsos Education Monitor 2026: support for banning AI in schools is LOWER in Asian markets, HIGHER in Australia/NZ. Breadth wide, depth shallow

column2: AI education LATAM Latin America 2026 adoption regulation players
column5: UNESCO Observatory on AI in Education for LAC launched Apr 2026 with ECLAC; partners CAF, CENIA (Chile), CETIC.br, Tec de Monterrey, ProFuturo, Fundacion Ceibal. UNESCO IESALC/UNU-IAS over 200 institutions in 19 countries: 87% use AI somewhere, only 26% have a formal strategy. Brazil Cetic.br 2026: 53% of school administrators use AI, 22% have guidelines. Argentina 75% high-SES vs 42% low-SES use (9-17). Uruguay signed the CoE convention 2025; Colombia CONPES 4144. NO LATAM country has an in-force regulation of AI IN EDUCATION specifically
